The **Deathclaw Gauntlet** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

The Gauntlet is made up of two (can be upgraded to three) Deathclaw Hands with a simple handhold and a cushioned brace to go around the wearer's wrist. This weapon cannot be used or equipped while wearing Power Armor.
